description: Create, update, or delete a product in brand memory (feeds article context + entity triples). Create: name+description+category. Update: productId + changed fields. Delete: productId + del=true.

category.description: Type of offer: core_product, add_on, service or product

description.description: What the product does, in a sentence or two

pricing.description: Price as you'd say it, like "$49/month"

productId.description: Product id from get_brand. Leave it out to create a product.

usps.description: What sets it apart, one point per item

name: write_brand_product
